_info: English interface strings. Keys are the Traditional Chinese source strings; a missing key falls back to the source text.
\n\n「%s」被其他程式佔用，請到設定換一組: %s is taken by another program. Pick another combination in Settings.
BitBlt 抓取桌面失敗: BitBlt failed to grab the desktop
CapWGC 已啟動（有熱鍵被佔用）: CapWGC is running (a hotkey is taken)
CapWGC 已經在執行（請看系統匣）。: CapWGC is already running (see the system tray).
Esc 或 Backspace 清除（＝不綁熱鍵）。除了 PrtScn，至少需要:
Esc or Backspace clears the field (= no hotkey). Except for PrtScn, at least one modifier is required; use Ctrl / Alt / Shift, because Windows swallows Win combinations first.
Combinations already taken by another program are reported after you press OK.
F12 是系統保留鍵，請換一個: F12 is reserved by Windows; pick another key
Media Foundation 啟動失敗，無法錄影。: Media Foundation failed to start, so recording is unavailable.
OCR 完成（複製失敗，需手動抄）: OCR finished (copy failed, copy it by hand)
OCR 引擎：模型固定放在程式旁邊的 models\\，不需要設定。\r\n工具:
OCR engine: the models live in the models\ folder next to the program; nothing to configure here.
A grey "OCR" on the toolbar means the engine did not load (the tray message says why, once).
Recognised text goes straight to the clipboard — no panel, no file on disk.
OCR 推論引擎版本不相容（%s）。OCR 會保持灰色，其他功能不受影響: The OCR inference engine version is incompatible (%s). OCR stays grey; everything else keeps working
OCR 未啟用（只提示這一次）: OCR is not enabled (this is the only notice)
OCR 模型沒有載入成功，請看托盤提示或 log: The OCR model did not load. Check the tray message or the log
OCR 模型載入失敗：%s: Failed to load the OCR model: %s
OCR 需要的檔案不在（models\\ 或 onnxruntime.dll），:
The files OCR needs are missing (models\ or onnxruntime.dll), so the OCR segment stays grey.
Recording, screenshots and region picking are unaffected — you can ignore this message.
When unzipping, keep the models folder and onnxruntime.dll together with the exe.
PrtScn 已被其他程式註冊: PrtScn is already registered by another program
PrtScn 沒有接手成功: PrtScn could not be taken over
Win 組合會被系統接走，抓不到；請改用 Ctrl / Alt / Shift: Windows intercepts Win combinations; use Ctrl / Alt / Shift instead
models 目錄不完整（需要 ppocr_det.onnx、ppocr_rec: The models folder is incomplete (needs ppocr_det.onnx, ppocr_rec.onnx and ppocr_dict.txt)
「%s」的組合已被其他程式使用，已維持原本的熱鍵: %s is already used by another program; the previous hotkey was kept
取得桌面 DC 失敗: Failed to get the desktop DC
取消勾選會把 PrtScn 還原給 Windows（原本沒設定過就維持沒設定），: Clearing the box gives PrtScn back to Windows (if it was never set, it stays unset) and moves the screenshot hotkey back to Ctrl+Alt+X.
回到右下角（錄影中會立刻歸位）: Back to the bottom-right corner (returns immediately while recording)
在設定裡勾選「麥克風」後再錄一次: Tick "Microphone" in Settings and record again
寫入剪貼簿失敗: Failed to write to the clipboard
截圖 / OCR（熱鍵進入後，上方工具列可切換）: Screenshot / OCR (switch on the toolbar at the top after the hotkey)
截圖時也存一份（檔案總管可直接貼上）: Also save a copy (so Explorer can paste it)
找不到 onnxruntime.dll（OCR 推論引擎）。OCR 會保持灰色，: onnxruntime.dll not found (the OCR inference engine). OCR stays grey; recording and screenshots still work
拖曳框選要錄製的區域: Drag to select the area to record
擷取目標沒有送出任何幀，已停止: The capture target stopped sending frames; recording stopped
沒有權限修改系統設定（可能被群組原則鎖住）: No permission to change system settings (maybe blocked by group policy)
無法寫入登錄檔（可能被群組原則或安全軟體封鎖）。其他設定已儲存。: Could not write to the registry (blocked by group policy or security software). Your other settings were saved.
無法建立框選項目: Could not create the region item
無法送出辨識請求: Could not send the recognition request
熱鍵至少要有一個修飾鍵（Ctrl / Alt / Shift）: A hotkey needs at least one modifier (Ctrl / Alt / Shift)
熱鍵（點欄位後直接按組合鍵）: Hotkeys (click a field, then press the combination)
用 PrtScn 取代 Windows 剪取工具（截圖 / OCR）: Use PrtScn instead of the Windows Snipping Tool (screenshot / OCR)
登錄到目前使用者的啟動項目，登入後常駐系統匣。\n只影響這個帳號，不需要系統管理:
Adds CapWGC to this user's startup items so it stays in the system tray after you sign in.
Affects this account only; no administrator rights needed.
目前沒有綁任何熱鍵，可從托盤或設定指定。: No hotkeys are bound. Use the tray menu or Settings.
目前由 CapWGC 接管。取消勾選會還原 Windows 的 PrtScn。: Currently taken over by CapWGC. Clearing the box gives PrtScn back to Windows.
確定後會關閉 Windows 11 的「使用 PrtScn 開啟剪取工具」（Wi: After you press OK, Windows 11's "Use the Print screen key to open Snipping Tool" is turned off (Win+Shift+S is unaffected) and PrtScn is bound to screenshot / OCR.
綁了同一組熱鍵: is bound to the same hotkey
讀不到系統設定（登錄檔的 Control Panel\\Keyboard）: Could not read the system setting (registry Control Panel\Keyboard)
讀不到虛擬桌面大小: Could not read the virtual desktop size
這次錄影沒有麥克風音軌: This recording has no microphone track
選區域錄影 / 拖曳框選: Record a region / drag to select
選擇錄影輸出資料夾: Choose the output folder for recordings
還原系統設定失敗，PrScn 可能仍由 CapWGC 接管: Failed to restore the system setting; PrtScn may still be taken over by CapWGC
開啟剪貼簿失敗（可能有其他程式正在使用）: Failed to open the clipboard (another program may be using it)
開機自動啟動沒有設定成功: Could not enable startup at sign-in
預設開啟。會關閉 Windows 11 的「使用 PrtScn 開啟剪取工具」（: On by default. Turns off Windows 11's "Use the Print screen key to open Snipping Tool" (Win+Shift+S is unaffected) and binds PrtScn to screenshot / OCR.
點一下選取，點兩下或按 Enter 開始錄影（截圖熱鍵仍可用）: Click to select, double-click or press Enter to start recording (the screenshot hotkey still works)
（存檔失敗，但已進剪貼簿）: (save failed, but it is on the clipboard)
